key.name: disabled-features
key.summary: Gnoblin features that are turned off
key.description: Ids of Gnoblin features that have been turned off. Features omitted from this list remain enabled; the built-in wallpaper is enabled by default. This setting is driven live over org.gnoblin.Shell (ListFeatures/GetFeature/SetFeature); see js/ui/components/gnoblinControl.js.
